verdict.rationale: Context.dev is fundamentally an API product with a public OpenAPI spec, documented endpoints (crawl, extract, screenshot, brand data, auth), API key management, rate-limit headers, plus a CLI and MCP server built on top of the same API — clear evidence of a documented, drivable public API for AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer confirmation of full API coverage beyond docs/probes.
